title: Larimer County Stanley Heights Public Improvement District No. 81 Ballot Issue 6A

measureRecord.whatItDoes: Create Stanley Heights Public Improvement District No. 81 and authorize a property-tax levy no higher than 13.791 mills, with collections beginning January 1, 2027. It would raise $48,000 in the first year, with later amounts based on collections. Money would improve and maintain district roads and pay general operating expenses. Property-tax proceeds, vehicle ownership-tax revenue and investment earnings could be kept and spent outside Colorado’s constitutional revenue and spending limits. The district could also collect and spend amounts above the statutory 5.5% property-tax limit in 2027 and later years.
measureRecord.yesMeans: Approve formation of the district, its property-tax levy and the revenue-limit exceptions.
measureRecord.noMeans: Do not approve forming the district or the proposed property tax and revenue-limit exceptions.

questionText: SHALL TAXES BE INCREASED $48,000.00 ANNUALLY (IN THE FIRST YEAR) OR SUCH GREATER AMOUNT AS IS RAISED IN SUBSEQUENT YEARS WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES OF THE PROPOSED STANLEY HEIGHTS PUBLIC IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT NO. 81 BY THE IMPOSITION OF AD VALOREM PROPERTY TAXES AT A MILL LEVY RATE NOT TO EXCEED 13.791 MILLS, THE REVENUES OF WHICH WILL BE COLLECTED BEGINNING JANUARY 1, 2027 AND EACH YEAR THEREAFTER, SUCH REVENUES TO BE USED FOR THE IMPROVEMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF ROADS AS REQUESTED IN THE PETITION FOR CREATION OF THE DISTRICT AND FOR THE GENERAL OPERATING EXPENSES; SHALL STANLEY HEIGHTS PUBLIC IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT NO. 81 BE CREATED; AND SHALL THE PROCEEDS OF SUCH TAXES, THE SPECIFIC OWNERSHIP TAXES RECEIVED BY THE DISTRICT AND INVESTMENT EARNING ON BOTH CONSTITUTE VOTER APPROVED REVENUE AND/OR SPENDING CHANGES AND BE COLLECTED AND SPENT BY THE DISTRICT WITHOUT REGARD TO ANY SPENDING, REVENUE RAISING OR OTHER LIMITATION CONTAINED WITHIN ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION; AND SHALL THE DISTRICT BE AUTHORIZED TO COLLECT AND EXPEND FROM ITS MILL LEVY ANY SUCH AMOUNT WHICH IS MORE THAN THE AMOUNT WHICH WOULD OTHERWISE BE PERMITTED UNDER THE 5.5% LIMIT IMPOSED BY SECTION 29-1-301, COLORADO REVISED STATUTES IN 2027 AND EACH YEAR THEREAFTER?
